alt: Unlabelled diagram of a nephron: renal corpuscle (glomerular tuft inside Bowman's capsule) in the cortex, proximal convoluted tubule, a long hairpin loop of Henle descending into the medulla and ascending again, and the collecting duct running down to the papilla.
